text:
harry: Quick question for month-end close: we ran the March pricing experiment for new signups and issued usage credits totaling USD 120,000 applied to invoices in March. Do we treat these as immediate contra-revenue or set up a deferral schedule?
olga: Can you paste the experiment terms and how credits were applied? Need to know if credits are unconditional rebates or tied to future performance.
harry: experiment terms: 30-day promo for new customers. Credits were issued at invoice generation and reduce customer balance immediately. But marketing ran an experiment clause that any unused credit expires after 90 days and is non-refundable.
ben: Revrec note: if credits are granted as a price concession for past delivered service, they reduce revenue in the period of the performance obligation (March). If they represent a future service entitlement, they'd be deferred.
tara: How were credits recognized operationally? Did we post a contra line on customer invoices or create a separate liability?
harry: engineering pushed credits as invoice line items with description "Promo credit - March experiment" which netted down invoice revenue on the bill. GL postings currently reduce revenue at invoicing.
olga: auditor POV: need to confirm whether credit is a post-delivery adjustment (so reduce March revenue) or an upfront marketing incentive that effectively creates a separate performance obligation. Given credits apply to historical usage (the invoice period that already occurred), sounds like contra-revenue.
ben: agree with olga. Recommend: 1) keep revenue reduction in March (no deferral), 2) document experiment terms, sample invoice, and expiry clause in close pack, 3) calculate gross vs net presentation impact for disclosures.
tara: one wrinkle: some credits were applied to prepay / committed accounts where customer had future entitlements. For those, we might need to record a deferred liability and amortize as entitlements are consumed. Need list of accounts impacted.
harry: i have the export with 47 accounts where credits hit committed bundles. i'll upload list to binder.
finance-bot: Reminder: "Month-end binder updated: file added by harry (pricing_experiment_credit_export_Mar2025.csv)" :white_check_mark:
olga: good. tara please review the 47 committed accounts and make call on whether those are contra-revenue or deferred. If deferred, propose schedule and JE: debit Promo Expense or Contra-Revenue? credit Deferred Credits (2502).
tara: i'll review now. Preliminary: for committed accounts where credit increases customer entitlement to future months, we'll book a liability (2502) and amortize against revenue as they consume. For the rest, book as contra-revenue in March.
ben: include disclosure calc: total gross revenue affected, net revenue after credits, and a memo explaining judgment. auditors will want a sample of the contract language and the promo terms.
harry: uploaded sample SOW and promo T&Cs to binder and tagged tara/olga.
ara: (typo) — sorry ignore
finance-bot: Month-end binder updated: JE template and memo uploaded by tara (JE_2025-03_PROMO_CREDITS.xlsx). :white_check_mark:
tara: draft JE for netting case: Debit Revenue Contra (4015) USD 73,500, Credit Accounts Receivable / Cash offsets as applicable. For deferred case: Debit Promo Expense or Contra-Revenue? we'll use Contra-Revenue only for non-committed accounts; for committed accounts: Debit Marketing Promo Expense (6150) and Credit Deferred Credits (2502) then amortize to revenue.
olga: please also include approval notes. harry can approve up to 50k, this is 120k total so need L2 sign-off. tara, ben please sign after review.
envelope: (system) harry approved up to 50k in binder.
ben: Reviewed and signed off on the approach. tara to finalize JE and post before close.
tara: posted JE drafts, tagged @olga for L2 approval.
olga: Approved. JE posted to GL (JE# 2025-03-1304). Close memo updated noting that USD 46,500 of credits were deferred for committed accounts and USD 73,500 reduced March revenue.
harry: thanks team. Closing action: tara to retain analysis for auditors. Closing thread for March close. :heavy_check_mark:
